decisions.title: Menaul Redevelopment Study and Recommendations
decisions.description: This City Council draft analyzes Menaul land use, zoning, property conditions, business and retail market, community input, and redevelopment recommendations. It was adopted as policy in 2021 and preceded the adopted 2023 MRA plan.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-21-207 matter record verified
processing_notes: The rendered R-21-207 detail page identifies this attachment as the Menaul Redevelopment Study Draft and records the resolution as enacted.
The document is retained as the adopted-policy precursor to the 2023 Menaul MRA Plan, not as the current area plan.

decisions.title: Menaul Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: The adopted 2023 plan sets redevelopment goals, opportunity-area strategies, land-use and circulation actions, business and housing priorities, public investments, and implementation steps for the Menaul area north of I-40.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-22-92 matter record verified
processing_notes: The rendered R-22-92 detail page identifies this attachment as the adopted final Menaul MRA Plan and records the resolution as enacted.

decisions.title: University MRA Designation Report
decisions.description: The 2022 designation report documents existing conditions, boundary and eligibility findings, market conditions, community context, and redevelopment needs used to establish the University Metropolitan Redevelopment Area before its later plan.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-22-38 matter record verified
processing_notes: The rendered R-22-38 detail page identifies this report as Exhibit B and records the designation resolution as enacted.

decisions.title: Menaul MRA Zoning Map Amendment
decisions.description: The enacted 2025 ordinance rezones approximately 29 acres in the Menaul MRA from NR-LM and NR-C to MX-M, implementing the adopted plan's mixed-use and multifamily-development recommendation.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered O-25-100 matter record verified
processing_notes: The rendered O-25-100 detail page identifies this signed enacted attachment and records ordinance O-2025-033 as enacted.

decisions.title: 2026 Infrastructure Capital Improvements Plan Priorities
decisions.description: The enacted 2026 resolution establishes the City's ICIP priorities, framing capital investment across housing, public safety, transportation, facilities, technology, redevelopment, resilience, and other public infrastructure.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-26-9 matter record verified
processing_notes: The rendered R-26-9 detail page identifies this signed enacted attachment and records resolution R-2026-024 as enacted.
